summary: Add scoped recent changes to the web status bar with build-time public manifests and device-local acknowledgement.

replay.detail: No daemon claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema changes; acknowledgement uses a new browser-local preference.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordination rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The web build emits changelog.v1.json and the Changes disclosure shows entries included in that build. No protocol changes or coordinated upgrade required.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or startup migration required.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the disclosure; browser-local seen IDs do not affect daemon state.
